original_baseline.algorithm: Discoverer.shape(ret,n,me): original attraction propagation, conductance and first-action path extraction

added_mechanisms.purpose: standalone exact-rational symbolic-rule induction from observed before/action/after pairs; additive benchmark, never substitutes for the original maze Discoverer.shape
added_mechanisms.hypothesis_language: finite exact-rational expressions over a,b,c, zero and one; depth <=2

actual_observed_results: GitHub Actions run 42342782254 / commit 6c1a3dab556f8e731abb65d5aad66e5e9f435f19: 19/19 PASS (4 original math, 8 induced, 7 original V17); 5/5 algebra rules inferred from 320 observations; unseen 512/512 original-range and 1024/1024 wider coefficient full predicted paths; 2048/2048 OOD algebra examples with 10,240 verified symbolic transitions; cold/no-essential-rules/no-original-maze-training 0/64 each. New isolated docs only; no native general math or UI claimed.
limitations: Rule hypothesis grammar and factored equation stage structure are provided
Mathematical transition observation source is a controlled teacher environment
Separate learned math library is not yet the native single persistent Brain checkpoint
Mathematical goal cells and routes are projected into a V17 retinal grid before Discoverer.shape()
No OpenThoughts3 semantic or real Windows CUDA test in this experiment
